name: Do the opportunity feed's 15M + 5M LONG/SHORT cards predict the next move?
question: After the app's Fırsat Akışı shows a LONG or SHORT card, does the pair then move in that direction by more than the trading cost?
what_is_tested: The app's own scan code, compiled from forex_web_app_streamlit_v14_alert_decision.py by feed_replay.py: analyse_symbol, global_bias, build_market_model_status (default filters on, entry model 'Düzeltme + Tepki') and scanner_opportunity_from_row in 'Dengeli Sinyal' mode with backtest quality off (the default), so a card is 'LONG/SHORT ÖN İZLEME' only when the structure gate passes. Only data fetching is replaced: at each moment the replay returns what the app would have downloaded (forming bar last, dropped by analyse_symbol; 4h rebuilt from hourly like the app).
decision_times: Every 15 minutes (on 15-minute boundaries) while the market is open, for both entry timeframes (15 Dakika and 5 Dakika)

backtest.pairs: All 28 pairs of the app except EURZAR

live_data_replay.data: Yahoo Finance, the app's live source: 5m and 15m for the last 60 days, 60m for 180 days, downloaded on 2026-09-27
live_data_replay.period: From five days after the first available Yahoo 5m bar to 2026-09-25 (the last trading day)
live_data_replay.note: This is the closest thing to a forward test that can be run today: the exact live pipeline on the live data source, including two weeks after the local archive ends. A real forward test needs calls recorded as they happen.

calls: A new call is a LONG or SHORT card for a pair and entry timeframe that was not showing with the same side at the previous 15-minute scan. Repeated scans of the same card are not counted again.
outcome: Signed move in pips from the open of the 5-minute bar starting at the decision time to the last 5-minute open at or before decision time + horizon; horizons 15 minutes, 1 hour, 4 hours, 24 hours. Positive = the market moved the way the card said.
costs: Net move = signed move minus the measured round-trip cost for that pair and New York hour (data/ml/spread_profile.json median + 0.7 pip commission)
statistics: Per entry timeframe and horizon: hit rate (signed move > 0), mean signed and net pips, with 95% bootstrap intervals resampling calendar days (2000 resamples, seed 42) so same-day calls stay together
success_criterion: LONG/SHORT cards count as useful if, for at least one entry timeframe, the mean net move is above zero with the 95% interval above zero at both the 1-hour and the 4-hour horizon in the backtest. The live-data replay is reported alongside and must not contradict it (mean net move at 1 and 4 hours not below zero).
information_only: The same measures for moments where the direction rule passed but the structure gate blocked the card, to show whether the gate adds value; results by call score.
parameter_search: None: the app's defaults are tested as they are
